notes.title: Patch 0.0.7 Added the ability to reset the progress of an incident
notes.notes: You can now reset the number of anomalies discovered by clicking "Reset Game" at the bottom left of the settings screen.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.6 Changes in anomaly probability
notes.notes: The same incident will not occur until the incident is completed.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.5 Made the game more comfortable to play.
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where there was one more abnormality in the total
Adapting object mosaic processing to reduce information content

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2 Fixed some bugs
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where some changes were not executed.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1 Content Enhancements
notes.notes: We have expanded the content after clearing the game and adjusted the anomalies.
